story.summary: Allow agents to reject poor AI drafts with a reason, log analytics, and optionally write a correct answer. Rejection reasons feed analytics; manual correction option; auto-load next item. [Source: 5-4-rejection-flow.md]

requirements.requirement: Rejection modal with reason options; agent selects reason and confirms.
Item removed from queue, reason logged, optional manual answer.
Rejection reasons feed analytics; alert triggers on high rejection rate.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Rejection modal with reason options; agent selects and confirms.
Item removed, reason logged, manual answer optional.
Analytics fed by rejection reasons; alert on high rejection rate.

structure.backend: API for rejection flow: log reason, manual answer, dequeue item, trigger alert.
structure.frontend: Rejection UI: modal, reason selection, manual answer field, auto-load next item, alerting.
